extension.description: Unofficial Kodi Amazon Music Add-on - Kodi extention to browse and play Amazon Music songs. An Amazon account is necessary. Inputstream Adaptiv needs to be activated and the latest widevine verion installed.
extension.disclaimer: Some parts of this addon may not be legal in your country of residence - please check with your local laws before installing. All used images are from Amazon.
extension.news: v2.1.0 - New: Newly released and popular albums and songs. - New: The artists in your personal library. - The menus list their entries in the same order. The recommendations are gone from the main menu; Playlists and Albums keep theirs. - Playlists and albums that cannot be played are no longer listed. - Entries are always marked by colour; the setting for it is gone. - Clearer names for the library entries and the sign-in domain.
